title: Start here — Queue Fabric v0.9-dev5
summary: ooRexx-native queue/work-package substrate with MQ-like wiring semantics. It is not a shell job queue and not an IBM MQ compatibility layer. Rich ooRexx object graphs remain inside the fabric; encoding/projection occurs only at persistence/SQL/transport boundaries.
invariants: SQL/NoSQL is observability/query projection, not internal representation.
v0.9-dev5 is a development cut; do not call v0.9 released until full matrix/Alchemy Autobuild closure.
